subject: Re: Invoice cadence & net-terms request for Nimbus Health
messages:
From: Claudia Ross <claudia.ross@nimbushealth.com>
To: logan_wright@redwood.com
Cc: finance@nimbushealth.com
Date: Thu, 10 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: Net60 + credit line for pilot

Hi Logan,

Thanks again for the walkthrough yesterday. Procurement has one ask before we can push the pilot into our onboarding queue: can Redwood support Net60 terms and a $250,000 credit limit for the pilot and anticipated ramp?

Operational notes from our side:
- We need monthly invoices (30-day cadence between invoices) but payment terms of 60 days for each invoice.
- VAT: our European legal entity will need invoices that either show reverse-charge (we'll provide VAT ID) or include VAT as applicable — legal is strict about EU VAT evidence.
- PO number will be supplied for each invoice; prefer ACH but can do wire for the first invoice.

We're trying to avoid upfront prepayment if possible. Can you confirm what documentation you need (SOC2, region of data processing) and any credit checks or trading references Redwood requires?

If Net60 and $250k are acceptable, we'll route the MSA amendment to Legal and start signatures.

Best,
Claudia Ross
Director, Procurement
Nimbus Health

--

From: Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.com>
To: Claudia Ross <claudia.ross@nimbushealth.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 11 Sep 2026 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: Net60 + credit line for pilot

Claudia —

Really appreciate the clear ask. Quick summary of what we can do today and a suggested compromise so we get the pilot moving without exposing either side to operational risk: 

Proposal (commercial):
- Terms: Net30 for the first 90 days of billing, converting to Net45 thereafter if payment performance is on-time for the first three invoices.
- Credit limit: provisional $150,000 to start, increased to $250,000 after two clean cycles / successful payment history.
- Initial deposit: 1x invoice (applied to the first month) OR card-on-file for one month as fallback — we can be flexible.
- VAT: we can issue invoices to your EU subsidiary with reverse-charge if you provide VAT ID. We will need the VAT evidence before the first EU invoice.
- Documentation: SOC2 Type II report (redacted summary) and our data processing addendum; I can share both.

Operational notes:
- We'll issue invoices monthly. For predictable forecasting, we can provide a milestone-based invoice sample (attached).
- Payment methods accepted: ACH (preferred), wire (for the first invoice), and corporate card for smaller initial amounts.

I've attached a short invoice cadence proposal (Proposal_invoice_plan.xlsx) to show how the provisional limit and ramp would work. If that sounds reasonable, I'll loop in Ben from finance to finalize collection mechanics and update the MSA amendment.

Thanks,
Logan Wright
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
log an_wright@redwood.com

--
Attachment: Proposal_invoice_plan.xlsx (XLSX)

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>

Cc: logan_wright@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 14 Sep 2026 08:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: Net60 + credit line for pilot

Hi Claudia —

Quick note from finance on Logan's suggestion. Happy to find a middle ground. Our recommended approach that balances risk and deal velocity: 

1) Net45 standard terms (rather than Net30) with a $200,000 credit line to start.
2) Initial security: first invoice = deposit (applied to month 1) OR a signed pre-authorized payment method on file.
3) If you pay early (within 10 days) we'll pass a 2% credit on that invoice as an incentive.
4) After two consecutive on-time clears, we increase the limit to $250k.

A couple of administrative asks: please provide your VAT ID for EU billing and a PO number per invoice. We will also need a short credit form completed for new enterprise partners (I can send that over).

If you agree, I can draft the exact language for the MSA amendment and create the DocuSign envelope so we can sign quickly.

Cheers,
Ben Carter
Finance Manager | Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.com

Ben / Logan —

Thanks for the patience while I ran this by legal and treasury. Two clarifications from our side: 
1) VAT: our German subsidiary will supply the VAT ID and asks that invoices sent to the EU entity reflect reverse-charge language; if Redwood needs to list VAT explicitly we need that reflected as a separate line and with the correct tax code.
2) Payment window: Net60 is preferred by our treasury team due to intercompany cash management — would Redwood consider Net60 if we provide a 30-day deposit? That would preserve treasury cadence while giving Redwood near-term payment coverage.

Also, finance asked for the SOC2 report and a vendor contact to expedite the credit form (we want a single point of contact at Redwood for collections).

If acceptable, I will ask legal to prepare the PO and flag any MSA redlines related to payment language.

Best,
Claudia

From: Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.com>

Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 22 Sep 2026 16:38:00 -0700
Subject: Final: Terms agreed (Net45 variant + deposit)

Claudia —

Thanks — appreciate the constructive back-and-forth. Per internal approvals and Ben's guidance, here's the mutually acceptable set of terms we can commit to today: 

Final commercial terms:
- Billing cadence: monthly invoices issued on the 1st of each month (sample attached).
- Payment terms: Net45 effective immediately.
- Initial deposit: one-month invoice as deposit to be paid within 30 days of the first invoice issuance. This preserves your treasury cadence while covering Redwood's early ramp.
- Credit limit: $200,000 initial; increase to $250,000 after two consecutive on-time payments.
- VAT routing: Redwood will invoice your EU subsidiary with reverse-charge language. Please provide the VAT ID and business address prior to the first EU invoice; see Invoice_Sample.pdf for format.
- Methods: ACH preferred; wire for initial deposit accepted.

Next steps / action items:
1) Logan: send MSA amendment (MSA_Amendment_net45.pdf) via DocuSign with the agreed lines.
2) Claudia: provide VAT ID and confirm which legal entity will receive invoices.
3) Ben: send the short credit form and collections contact info; we'll include a single collections email alias for Nimbus.

Related links: DocuSign envelope, HubSpot deal (see links below).

I'll attach the MSA amendment and a clean invoice sample for your legal/tax team. If that all checks out, we'll route the DocuSign for signature and schedule the onboarding kickoff the week after signatures.

Best,
Logan Wright
